narrative_shape: Read-only measurement that is still producing results. Turn 68 starts a name-matching baseline. Turn 73 calls an L2 result strong and real and starts an L0 rerun. Turn 75 arms a monitor for that rerun. Bash 70, Read 5, Monitor 4, one Edit and one Write, no path at ≥3 reads, compactions 0. Single checkpoint. The shape is a measurement loop, not standby-as-the-whole-session and not a code thrash.

phases.name: baseline, then L0 rerun
phases.note: Name-matching script, a stated L2 result, L0 rerun launched, monitor armed.

early_signals.signal: Starts the name-matching baseline for part 4.
Treats the L2 match as a real result and reruns scoped to level 0.
Monitor armed on that L0 rerun — a measurement wait, after a result, not the whole histogram.

rationale: Inside the only checkpoint the worker reports a result and widens the measurement. That is the trajectory. There is no reread table and no collapsed wait.
